test_inputs.explanation: The execution only reveals that the agent repeatedly interacted with the Customers grid at /admin/customer/ and finally opened a specific customer edit page at /admin/customer/edit/id/76/. No explicit filter values, text inputs, or dropdown selections are visible, so filter parameters are left empty/defaulted. The presence of an edit page with id/76/ indicates the agent successfully clicked an Edit link in the grid; to make this reproducible as a generic test, edit_row_index is set to 1 (click the first row after search). per_page is set to the common Magento default of 20, page_number to 1, and is_active to 'Any' to reflect an unfiltered grid. reset_before_search is set to true to ensure a clean state before applying filters or navigating and then opening a row for editing, which matches the behavior implied by repeated visits to the grid followed by a specific edit action.
